title: The New Repete G3:Verne
content:
The Repete G3:Verne answers the age-old question every roadie has on a ride: “What is down that gravel road?” With clearance for 45mm tires, this made-in-the-Czech-Republic frame delivers light, fast, road-bike-like riding off-road. Read below for all the details.

Repete G3:Verne Quick Hits

  • Frame Material Columbus Spirit HSS | Hi-performance Omnicrom Steel Alloy
  • Fork Columbus Trefoil Allroad | 1 1/8″ – 1 1/2″ or ENVE All-Road In-Route 1 1/8″ – 1 1/2″
  • Headset IS52/28,6 – IS52/40
  • Dropouts Stainless Steel Dropouts | Flatmount | UDH
  • Head Tube Tapered | 1 1/8″ – 1 1/2″
  • Bottom Bracket Shell T47 – 68mm
  • Rear Dropouts Spacing 142×12 | M12x1 | 167,7mm
  • Front Dropouts Spacing 100×12 | M12x1,5 | E-thru
  • Max Rotor Size Rear 160mm | Front 160mm
  • Seatpost Diameter 31,6mm
  • Seat Clamp Diameter 34,9mm
  • Front Derailleur Clamp Diameter 34,9mm
  • Maximum Tire Clearance 700×45 (Columbus Trefoil Allroad) | 700×40 (ENVE All-Road In-Route)
  • Cable Routing Internal Routing | EPS, Di2 and eTap Compatible

Repete G3:Verne Overview

Czech bicycle manufacturer Repete introduces the new steel gravel model G3: Verne. Refining a concept proven over seven years of riding, the bike delivers what riders in this segment seek most: a balance between speed on tarmac and confidence on unpaved surfaces. The G3: Verne arrives with fully integrated cable routing, UDH standard compatibility, and continues to rely on precise handcraft in Prague.
The philosophy behind the G3: Verne is a lively ride character and responsive handling. The frame is purposefully optimized for tire widths from 35 to 45 mm. This choice made it possible to retain a shorter fork and chainstay length, keeping the G3: Verne’s geometry compact and agile. Rider feedback over recent years has clearly shown that a fast gravel bike — one that flies on the road while easily handling off-road terrain — is the most versatile category.

Repete Refined

The new G3 model brings significant visual and structural refinements. Following the brand’s road model R3: Reason, it features fully integrated cable routing through a shaped head tube with stainless steel cups (IS52/IS52 system). The frame is fully compatible with electronic groupsets including eTap, Di2, and EPS, forming a clean aesthetic unit with the fork.

Repete’s signature dropouts have been redesigned: they are now 3D-printed from stainless steel and fully support the UDH standard. This ensures effortless replacement part availability anywhere in the world, alongside direct Full Mount derailleur compatibility for maximum shifting precision.

Customers can choose between two internally routed carbon forks: the Columbus Trefoil Allroad (tire clearance up to 45 mm) or the ENVE All-Road In-Route (clearance up to 40 mm).

Frame Details and Finish Options

The frameset is available in three standard colors (Digger, Birch, Termix). Repete also offers custom paint options, with a palette ranging from pure pastel tones to distinctive shades inspired by the automotive world.

The frame is crafted from Columbus Spirit HSS high-strength chromoly steel (Omnicrom alloy). Triple-butted tubing with wall thicknesses down to just 0.4mm maximizes mechanical strength at the lowest possible weight. Steel naturally provides high ride comfort and vibration damping without material degradation or changes in characteristics over time. Rear-end comfort is further enhanced by flattened seatstays. Stiffness in the bottom bracket area is ensured by oversized tubing combined with a threaded T47 bottom bracket, which also guarantees simple servicing.

Made in the Czech Republic

All frames are built in Repete’s Prague workshop. The brand emphasizes in-house development of structural frame details and segments, collaborating closely with local Czech manufacturers for CNC machining, stainless steel and nylon 3D printing, and stainless steel casting.
Numbered Launch Edition: To celebrate the release of the G3: Verne, Repete has prepared a limited edition of 10 numbered frames. Customers ordering their frame from this edition directly via the Repete website receive a custom frameset color of their choice at no additional charge (400 EUR value).
